specs.name: majorityElement_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    majorityElement nums h_precond ∈ nums

specs.name: majorityElement_count_gt_half
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    List.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) nums = nums.length / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_is_majority
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    let n := nums.length
    let result := majorityElement nums h_precond
    List.count result nums = n / 2

specs.name: majorityElement_others_leq_half
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    nums.all (fun x == x = majorityElement nums h_precond ∧
      List.count x nums = nums.length / 2)

specs.name: majorityElement_count_pos
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    List.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) nums = 0

specs.name: majorityElement_two_same
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (h : majorityElement_precond [x, x]),
    majorityElement [x, x] h = x

specs.name: majorityElement_count_exceeds_any
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    ∀ y : Int, y ≠ majorityElement nums h_precond →
    List.count y nums = List.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) nums

specs.name: majorityElement_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h : majorityElement_precond nums),
    majorityElement_postcond nums (majorityElement nums h) h

specs.name: majorityElement_unique
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    ∀ m : Int, List.count m nums = nums.length / 2 →
    m = majorityElement nums h_precond

specs.name: majorityElement_repeated_list
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    let r := majorityElement nums h_precond
    ∀ (h2 : majorityElement_precond (List.replicate (nums.length / 2 + 1) r)),
    majorityElement (List.replicate (nums.length / 2 + 1) r) h2 = r

specs.name: majorityElement_count_strictly_greater
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    2 * List.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) nums = nums.length

specs.name: majorityElement_count_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : majorityElement_precond nums),
    List.count (majorityElement nums h_precond) nums = nums.length

specs.name: majorityElement_appears_majority
specs.stmt: List Int) (h : majorityElement_precond nums) : (nums.filter (· == majorityElement nums h)).length * 2 > nums.length

matches.ground_truth:
let n := nums.length
  (List.count result nums > n / 2)

covered_specs:
let n := nums.length
  (List.count result nums > n / 2)
